detector.description: Alerts when at least one kafka partition is under replicated for at least 5m
detector.name: Kafka - Partition is under-replicated
detector.programText:
A = data('gauge.kafka-underreplicated-partitions').publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(0), lasting='5m'), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Kafka - Partition is under-replicated')

rules.description: The value of Underreplicated Partitions is above 0.
